# Alpha Presence

> [Alpha Presence](https://alphapresence.studio/) is a UK-based digital agency that helps UK local businesses fix their online presence. We work with trades, clinics, salons, cafés, gyms, independent retailers and small professional practices across the United Kingdom, building websites, improving user experience, automating admin work, optimising Google Business Profiles, and making businesses findable in both traditional search (Google, Bing) and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot). Everything is explained in plain English, scoped up front, and quoted at a fixed price.

## Services

- **Website Design & Build**: A fast, modern site that turns searches into enquiries. Typical local business sites are £1,200 to £4,500 and take 2 to 4 weeks.
- **UI/UX Design**: Clear journeys so visitors act instead of bouncing. Usually 1 to 3 weeks.
- **Automation**: Cut the admin. Bookings, follow-ups and forms on autopilot. Most setups are live within 1 to 2 weeks.
- **Branding & SEO/AEO/GEO**: Get found on Google and named in AI answers, through structured content, schema markup and consistent business details.
- **Google Business Profile Optimisation**: Rank in the map pack with a fully optimised profile: categories, services, photos, posts and review strategy. Usually 1 to 2 weeks.

## How to book a consultation

Consultations are free. Use the [Book a free consultation](https://alphapresence.studio/#book) form on the homepage (name, email, WhatsApp number, company name, the main challenge you're trying to solve, and your preferred day/time) and Alpha Presence replies within one business day. Visitors who aren't sure what they need can use the [talk to a human](https://alphapresence.studio/#talk-to-a-human) option to reach a person directly by WhatsApp, phone, or email instead.

## Notes

- Alpha Presence is an agency, not a software product. There is no visitor sign-up or login.
- Every project includes 30 days of post-launch support. Optional ongoing care plans start around £45/month, with no lock-in.
